entries.claim: AC7 is only restated as a human verification note; no task ensures the landing pull request contains all four required `Fixes` clauses or records evidence that the issues closed.
entries.failure_scenario: All three plans can be completed and every listed verification can pass while the pull request omits one or more of `Fixes #62`, `Fixes #5`, `Fixes #61`, and `Fixes #4`. The code then lands without closing all four issues, so AC7 and roadmap success criterion 5 remain unmet.

counter_evidence.note: AC7 is tagged human-verify and is checked after landing, outside every plan: the pull request body is written at /cad-land, which no plan task reaches. /cad-verify carries the criterion as a UAT item, as phase 1 did for its own Fixes #60 criterion (UAT.md:60-61 and item 12 at :109-110).

entries.claim: The fixture task defines six records but later applies its shape-isolation constraints to only “all five records,” leaving one record outside the stated constraints.
entries.failure_scenario: An implementer applies the unique-word, secret-name, sentinel-shape, and collision restrictions to only five of the six records. The omitted record can then collide with corpus searches or contain another matching shape, invalidating the per-turn proof that one specific rule produced the asserted marker.
